perItemFindings.label: S1
perItemFindings.one_line: The planned `FourWaveLaw` holds masses, an initial law, and kernel families, but not a joint full-data law/coupling for `X_t(0), X_t(1), X_t, D, Z`; it therefore cannot soundly host the a.s. consistency/no-anticipation atoms or the full-path witness/fiber claims bound by S1.

perItemFindings.label: def:compatible-fiber
perItemFindings.one_line: Its define-local note gives only a construction and no Causalean/Mathlib search trace or explicit no-fit rationale.

perItemFindings.label: def:exact-witness
perItemFindings.one_line: Its define-local note has no search trace establishing that no existing finite-law/witness construction fits; it only describes the intended construction.

perItemFindings.label: def:outside-face-pair
perItemFindings.one_line: Its define-local note has no search trace or explicit no-fit rationale for the generic compatible-law reallocation construction.

verbatim_critique: Re-plan S1 around a full-data finite probability-law object (or explicit joint potential-path coupling) from which observed paths, consistency, no anticipation, kernels, and both witness allocations are defined; a kernel-and-masses record alone is not world-sound for this core. Add re-runnable Causalean and, where relevant, Mathlib search/no-fit traces to the three untraced define-local nodes.
